headline: 17 contracts catalogued across 7 chains (BNB, Ethereum, Arbitrum, zkSync Era, Base, Manta, opBNB) from APX Finance legacy docs and Aster successor docs; no GitHub repo or audit covering bridge contracts specifically.

findings.text: Block-explorer name-tag search not directly performed (fetch calls exhausted after docs fetches); APX Finance and Aster addresses surfaced via official documentation pages which were fetched. Block-explorer verification for on-chain reads deferred to next run.

Two canonical deployment docs fetched: (1) Aster current docs at https://docs.asterdex.com/overview/smart-contracts.md listing Treasury contracts on BNB/ETH/Arbitrum and Earn/USDF token+minting contracts; (2) APX Finance legacy docs at https://apollox-finance.gitbook.io/apollox-finance/welcome/usdapx-token-and-contracts listing APX Exchange Treasury contracts on BNB/ETH/ARB/zkSync/Base/Manta and APX V2 Trading+ALP contracts on BNB/ARB/opBNB/Base. The APX Finance docs are the primary source for the 'APX Bridge' slug given the chain overlap with protocol.chains.

Audit reports page fetched at https://docs.asterdex.com/overview/audit-reports.md: 6 reports linked — AsterVault (2024-09-13), AsterEarn (2024-09-12), asBNB from Salus Security (2024-12-11), asBNB from PeckShield, USDF from PeckShield, USDF+asUSDF from HALBORN, asCAKE from Salus Security (2024-12-17). None appear to cover bridge/treasury contracts specifically; all PDF URLs are behind gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com and were not fetched. No APX Finance bridge-specific audit was surfaced.

No GitHub repository recorded in protocol.github and none discovered via search or docs pages. Docs pages are hosted on GitBook. APX Finance Aster Chain docs note 'Bridge contracts and related code will be publicly disclosed on the Smart Contract page' — implying code may not yet be open-sourced.

Multi-chain enumeration: APX Finance docs list Exchange Treasury on BNB (0xcEF2dD45Da08b37fB1c2f441d33c2eBb424866A4), Ethereum (0xb40eed68d7d6b3b6d6f4e93de6239b7c53efc786), Arbitrum (0xBAd4ccc91EF0dfFfbCAb1402C519601fbAf244EF), zkSync Era (0xD6f4e33063C881cE9a98e07E13673B92a637D908), Base (0x11db0BEb34766277a1d7CAc7590b3Cf4BBf5E4eB), Manta Pacific (0xBAd4ccc91EF0dfFfbCAb1402C519601fbAf244EF — same address as Arbitrum). opBNB: no Exchange Treasury listed; APX V2 Trading (0x5A5454A6030FB50ceb3eb78977D140198A27be5e) and ALP (0xC8424F526553ac394E9020DB0a878fAbe82b698C) found. Aster successor docs add Treasury on Scroll (0x7BE980E327692Cf11E793A0d141D534779AF8Ef4) not in protocol.chains.
No factory contracts identified in the fetched docs; factory enumeration not applicable for bridge/treasury architecture.

Role taxonomy applied: APX Exchange Treasury contracts classified as 'treasury'; APX MultisigWallet on BNB classified as 'multisig'; APX V2 Trading contracts classified as 'other' (pool-to-peer trading, not bridge); APX V2 ALP token contracts classified as 'token'; DAO contracts on BNB classified as 'admin'; APX token contract classified as 'token'.
All admin_addresses entries trace directly to fetched docs URLs (apollox-finance gitbook and asterdex docs). No snippet-only sightings; all addresses verified from fetched page bodies.

protocol_metadata.about: APX Bridge (now operating as Aster, the successor to APX Finance) is a multi-chain perpetual DEX and cross-chain treasury system that allows users to deposit, trade, and withdraw assets across BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Manta Pacific, opBNB, and zkSync Era without manually bridging. The protocol uses an off-chain order matching with on-chain settlement model (V1 order book) and a fully on-chain pool-to-peer perpetual trading model (V2) backed by ALP liquidity pools. APX Finance merged with Astherus in late 2024 and rebranded as Aster in March 2025, with APX token holders migrating to the ASTER token via a defined exchange program. Cross-chain deposits require 3-of-4 validator node verification, and withdrawals require 2-of-3 validator confirmation.
